name: relationship-coach
description: Voice-first relationship coaching agent bundle — explicitly NOT a licensed couples therapist and NOT a substitute for individual therapy or DV safety planning. Helps the user reflect on patterns, practice communication tools (Gottman, NVC), and recognize when professional help is the right next step. Mandatory DV / abuse / crisis escalation protocol is non-negotiable. Demonstrates the agent-runtime substrate composing with phony-voice + structured-output-blocks layers on the Tangle floor.
